steps.name: summary per repository
steps.prompt: Read the JSON file ~/.swarmery/wtcleanup/last-scan.json. A command wrote it minutes ago: it lists the worktrees the swarmery janitor keeps because their branch has unmerged commits, narrowed to those whose plan phase or board card is closed. `repos` holds the counts per repository: `byProof` (landing = the phase's PR merged; content-diff = merging the branch into main changes nothing; none = not proven) and `skipped` (why the other kept worktrees are not candidates); `candidates` lists each worktree with its owner and proof. Write ONE short paragraph per repository: how many candidates by proof kind, how many were skipped and why, and anything unusual in the proof details. Report only what the file says. Make no decisions and no recommendations, run no other command, and change nothing: the operator decides on the Needs-you card.
